evals.prompt:
Kannst du checken ob die Story ready ist bevor ich sie in den Sprint zieh?

Titel: Passwort-Reset E-Mail versenden
Als registrierter Benutzer möchte ich eine E-Mail zum Zurücksetzen meines Passworts erhalten, um wieder Zugriff auf mein Konto zu bekommen, falls ich es vergessen habe.

Parent Feature: Account Management
Priorität: Hoch

Akzeptanzkriterien:
- Given ein Benutzer klickt auf 'Passwort vergessen' und gibt seine registrierte E-Mail ein, When er auf 'Senden' klickt, Then erhält er innerhalb von 5 Minuten eine E-Mail mit einem Reset-Link
- Given der Reset-Link ist älter als 24h, When der Benutzer ihn öffnet, Then wird eine Fehlermeldung angezeigt

Technischer Ansatz: Nutzung des bestehenden Email-Service (SendGrid), neuer Endpoint POST /auth/reset-password
Betroffene Systeme: Auth-Service, Email-Service

Schätzung: noch offen
evals.expected_output: A DoR checklist grouped by the 8 sections. Should flag: no explicit effort estimate (section 6, 'Schätzung: noch offen'), no tasks listed (section 7), and should reasonably flag section 8 (Compliance & Security) as relevant/needing more detail since this touches auth/password-reset — not just wave it through as N/A. Acceptance criteria (section 3), formal structure (section 2), and content/goal (section 1) should be marked as satisfied. Section 4 (UX) should be judged N/A or flagged since there's a UI flow (forgot-password screen) implied but no mockups mentioned — good edge case, either judgment is defensible as long as it's explained.

assertions.text: Flags the missing effort estimate (section 6, 'Schätzung: noch offen') as unmet, not satisfied
Flags that no implementation tasks are listed (section 7) as unmet
Marks acceptance criteria (section 3) as satisfied, since two Given/When/Then criteria are present
Overall verdict is 'not yet ready' / 'noch nicht ready', not a blanket 'ready'
Does not fabricate details not present in the story (e.g. does not claim tasks or an estimate exist)
Output is organized by the DoR's numbered sections (1-8), not a free-form paragraph

evals.prompt:
Ist das schon ready für den Sprint?

Story: 'Dashboard verbessern'
Man sollte das Dashboard schneller und schöner machen.
evals.expected_output: A DoR checklist that clearly comes out NOT ready — should flag missing user-story format (section 2), no acceptance criteria (section 3), unclear scope/goal (section 1), no technical approach or affected systems (section 5), no estimate (section 6), no tasks (section 7). Should not invent details that aren't there (e.g. shouldn't assume a Parent feature exists). Verdict should be an unambiguous 'not ready.'

assertions.text: Overall verdict clearly states the story is not ready
Flags that the story doesn't follow the 'Als <Rolle> möchte ich <Ziel>, um <Grund>' format (section 2)
Flags that no acceptance criteria exist (section 3)
Does not invent details not present in the input (e.g. does not assume a Parent feature, estimate, or technical approach exists)
Recommends concrete next steps (e.g. refinement, splitting into smaller stories) rather than just listing failures

evals.prompt:
Kann ich die Story jetzt auf Done setzen? PR ist hier:

PR #482: feat(auth): add password reset email flow
- Implemented POST /auth/reset-password endpoint
- Added unit tests for token generation and expiry
- Ran eslint, no warnings
- Acceptance criteria met, verified manually against staging
- PR still needs a second reviewer approval
- Docs not updated yet, will do that in a follow-up
evals.expected_output: A DoD (User Story level) checklist. Should flag as ❌ or ❓: PR review not yet done (section 5 — explicitly stated as still needed), documentation not updated (section 6 — should NOT be waved through just because the user says 'follow-up', since a new endpoint plausibly needs doc updates), PO acceptance not mentioned (section 1). Should mark ❓ (not verifiable from text) rather than ✅ for things like 'all unit tests pass', 'CI pipelines green', 'branch merged' since none of that was confirmed in the text — a good run should NOT rubber-stamp these as done just because tests were 'added'. Overall verdict should be 'not yet done.'

assertions.text: Flags missing second reviewer approval as unmet (❌), not satisfied
Flags documentation as not updated / a gap, not waved through just because the user framed it as a 'follow-up'
Does not mark 'CI pipelines green' / 'all unit tests pass' as ✅ verified, since no CI status was given in the input
Does not mark PO acceptance as done, since it wasn't mentioned in the input
Overall verdict states the story is not yet done / not ready to close
